## `did.value.typescript.legacy-v1`

- Canonical: `identus-did::Did` at `edf03abcc963d37703daa61192940394bdc553ca` (unreleased-workspace-0.0.0).
- Language source: `@hyperledger/identus-sdk` 8.1.4 at `4bf86ebf69d5e96616a148e4c973f831f95fa38e`, `packages/shared/domain/src/models/DID.ts`.
- Compatibility: deprecated, bidirectional, lossless; window `>=8.1.4,<10.0.0`.
- Resource policy: at most 2048 bytes; redaction `caller-input`.
- Migration: Construct the Rust value first, then project the legacy DTO until SDK-TS exposes a canonical-value facade.
- Replacement: SDK-TS additive DID facade backed by the serialized Rust value and stable error code.
- Observability: Record mapping ID, direction, result class, and stable Rust error code without input values.
- Fallback: No parser fallback; reject values refused by identus-did.
- Rollback: Restore the prior SDK-TS parser while retaining this mapping record as historical evidence.
- Removal gate: All supported SDK-TS consumers use the Rust-backed additive DID facade and its migration window has elapsed.
- Vectors: `did.syntax.valid-basic`, `did.syntax.valid-colon-segments`, `did.syntax.valid-percent-case`, `did.syntax.consumer-shared-basic`, `did.syntax.consumer-shared-percent`, `did.syntax.max-bytes`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `serialized` | `uuid` | identity | both | true |
| `literal:did` | `schema` | derived-constant | rust-to-language | true |
| `method` | `method` | identity | both | true |
| `method_specific_id` | `methodId` | rename | both | true |


## `did-url.value.typescript.legacy-v1`

- Canonical: `identus-did::DidUrl` at `edf03abcc963d37703daa61192940394bdc553ca` (unreleased-workspace-0.0.0).
- Language source: `@hyperledger/identus-sdk` 8.1.4 at `4bf86ebf69d5e96616a148e4c973f831f95fa38e`, `packages/shared/domain/src/models/DIDUrl.ts`.
- Compatibility: deprecated, rust-to-language, lossy; window `>=8.1.4,<10.0.0`.
- Resource policy: at most 4096 bytes; redaction `caller-input`.
- Migration: Use Rust as the parser and source of truth; reject unsupported reverse projection and introduce an additive exact-value facade.
- Replacement: SDK-TS additive DID URL facade preserving serialized, raw query, and presence state.
- Observability: Record mapping ID, direction, unsupported-case ID, and stable Rust error code without URL values.
- Fallback: No lossy reverse fallback and no alternate parser after identus-did rejection.
- Rollback: Restore the prior SDK-TS parser while retaining unsupported-case telemetry and this historical mapping.
- Removal gate: All supported SDK-TS consumers use the exact-value facade and no named unsupported legacy round trip remains.
- Vectors: `did-url.syntax.valid-components`, `did-url.syntax.empty-query`, `did-url.syntax.empty-fragment`, `did-url.syntax.max-bytes`.

### Fields

| Rust | Language | Transform | Direction | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `did` | `did` | nested-did-mapping | rust-to-language | true |
| `path` | `path` | split-path-segments | rust-to-language | true |
| `query` | `parameters` | parse-to-map | rust-to-language | false |
| `fragment` | `fragment` | optional-to-string | rust-to-language | false |

### Unsupported legacy round trips

| Case | Reason | Required behavior | Stable adapter error |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `did-url.raw-query-round-trip` | A TypeScript Map cannot preserve raw query ordering or duplicate names. | Reject reverse conversion and require the additive exact-value facade. | `adapter.unsupported_lossy_mapping` |
| `did-url.empty-query-presence` | The legacy shape cannot distinguish an absent query from an explicitly empty query. | Reject reverse conversion and require the additive exact-value facade. | `adapter.unsupported_lossy_mapping` |
| `did-url.empty-fragment-presence` | The legacy string cannot distinguish an absent fragment from an explicitly empty fragment. | Reject reverse conversion and require the additive exact-value facade. | `adapter.unsupported_lossy_mapping` |


## `did.error.invalid-did.typescript.legacy-v1`

- Canonical: `identus-did::did.invalid_did` at `edf03abcc963d37703daa61192940394bdc553ca` (unreleased-workspace-0.0.0).
- Language source: `@hyperledger/identus-sdk` 8.1.4 at `4bf86ebf69d5e96616a148e4c973f831f95fa38e`, `packages/shared/domain/src/models/errors/Castor.ts`.
- Compatibility: deprecated, rust-to-language, lossy; window `>=8.1.4,<10.0.0`.
- Resource policy: at most 2048 bytes; redaction `caller-input`.
- Migration: Expose the stable Rust code beside the legacy class, then migrate callers from class/message matching to the code.
- Replacement: SDK-TS adapter error carrying did.invalid_did with a redacted legacy class facade.
- Observability: Record did.invalid_did and mapping ID; never record rejected input or the donor message.
- Fallback: No fallback parser and no raw input in the legacy error.
- Rollback: Retain InvalidDIDString while disabling the Rust adapter; keep stable-code telemetry disabled with it.
- Removal gate: All supported consumers match did.invalid_did rather than the legacy class or message.
- Vectors: `did.syntax.invalid-prefix`, `did.syntax.invalid-method`, `did.syntax.trailing-colon`, `did.syntax.missing-method`, `did.syntax.missing-method-specific-id`, `did.syntax.invalid-percent`, `did.syntax.non-ascii`, `did.syntax.url-delimiter`, `did.syntax.over-max-bytes`.

### Errors

| Rust code | Legacy class | Stable message | Preserve code | Redact input |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `did.invalid_did` | `CastorError.InvalidDIDString` | false | true | true |
